About this extension
This Add-on will do its best to bring back the lost gravity mode from Quizlet. In order to do this, I had to remake gravity from the ground up.

On any Quizlet study set page, you'll see a new button along with all of the other ways to study called "gravity" when you click this, it may take a second or two and may need a second click as its compiling the entire set list and sending it to another html.

In this HTML include several fun and awesome features like:
- Full gravity game functionality
* falling asteroids with terms
* answer box
* red asteroids
* scores
- Great customization
* Chose between typing the Term or the Description
* display the text, the image, or both on the asteroid
* choose which terms to study
* button to quickly select terms you failed to answer
- A leaderboard
* Unfortunately, there is no online connectivity, so all scores will be local
* Each study set gets its own leaderboard
* leaderboards persist through browser sessions

And absolutely NO data collection. There isn't even any data to collect!
